title: Jira connections
intro: The Jira Cloud sites Astrolabe observes. Astrolabe only reads from Jira, to detect deviations from the plan; nothing is ever written back. Administrators manage the connections.
loadFailed: Could not load the Jira connections
notFound: This Jira connection does not exist (or was deleted).

stub.title: This connection's calls go to the built-in development Jira stub, not to Atlassian

field.siteUrlHint: The Jira Cloud site, exactly https://your-tenant.atlassian.net
field.siteUrlFixed: The site is the connection's identity and cannot change. Create a new connection for another site.
field.apiTokenHint: An Atlassian API token (create it under your Atlassian account's security settings). It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
field.apiTokenKeep: A token is stored. Leave blank to keep the current token, or enter a new one to replace it.
field.apiTokenMissing: No token is stored. Enter one.
field.projectKeysHint: The Jira projects in scope (1 to 50). Type a key and press Enter.
field.pollIntervalHint: How often Astrolabe reads Jira on its own: every 5 minutes up to once a day (1440). A connection that is disabled or not yet tested is not polled.

validation.siteUrlInvalid: The site must be exactly https://your-tenant.atlassian.net (no path, port or trailing slash)
validation.emailTooLong: The email must be at most 254 characters
validation.emailInvalid: Enter the email address of the Atlassian account
validation.apiTokenTooLong: The API token must be at most 1,000 characters
validation.projectKeysInvalid: “{{key}}” is not a Jira project key (capital letters, digits and underscores, 2 to 10 characters, starting with a letter)
validation.projectKeysDistinct: Each project key can be listed once

saveForbidden: Only administrators can manage Jira connections
saveConflict: A connection with this name already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This connection no longer exists — reload the page
deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and every link between a plan item and a Jira item made through it will be unlinked. Nothing is changed in Jira.
deleteBodyNoLinks: “{{name}}” will be deleted. It has no links to live plan items. Nothing is changed in Jira.
deleteBodyLinks_one: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and its {{count}} link between a live plan item and a Jira item will be unlinked. Nothing is changed in Jira.
deleteBodyLinks_other: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and its {{count}} links between live plan items and Jira items will be unlinked. Nothing is changed in Jira.

toast.savedRetest: Connection saved. Test it again, the settings changed

test.scopeNote: A 401 on one probe while “myself” passes means the token is missing that probe's scope, not that the credentials are wrong. Add the scope shown on the failed row to the token.
test.stubNote: This test was answered by the built-in development Jira stub, not by Atlassian: while JIRA_STUB_BASE_URL is set, a site whose address starts with https://stub- is routed to the stub.

refresh.invalid: This connection cannot be refreshed (it is disabled or gone)
refresh.alreadyRunning: A refresh is already running for this connection. Its progress shows in the table below.
refresh.running: A refresh is running. The table below updates by itself.

details.mappingDefaults: Not saved yet (a run would use the defaults)
details.testedBefore: Not tested since the connection was last changed

report.title: Discovery report
report.counts: On the site: {{fields}} and {{types}}, read {{at}} UTC.
report.truncated: The site has more date, number and recognised fields than the snapshot keeps; some fields cannot be chosen below.
report.noLevels: The site reports no issue-type hierarchy levels.

found.legacyEpicLink: A legacy Epic Link field exists: {{field}}.
found.legacyParentLink: A legacy Parent Link field exists: {{field}}. Parent relations may use it instead of the standard parent field.

missing.targetStart: Target start was not found. Plans' own start field is missing, so the default start falls back to “Start date”; check the start fields below.
missing.targetEnd: Target end was not found. The default end falls back to the due date; check the end fields below.
missing.startDate: No “Start date” date field was found.
missing.dueDate: The due date field was not found.
missing.storyPoints: No story-points number field was found, so no estimate is mapped by default.
missing.team: No Team field was found, so teams are not read from Jira.

mapping.testFirst: Test the connection first. The field mapping needs the fields and issue types a test discovers on the site.
mapping.problemsTitle: The saved mapping no longer fits this site
mapping.sourceDefaults: Nothing is saved yet: the form shows the defaults found on the site, and a run would use them as they are. Save to keep them.
mapping.milestoneHint: Required. The Jira items that are milestones.

optionalHint.program: Optional. Leave unset if Jira has no level for programs.
optionalHint.project: Optional. Leave unset if Jira has no level for projects.

mapping.factorHint: Greater than 0, at most 1000, two decimals. Leave empty if unknown: the Jira figure is then shown but never compared.
mapping.teamFieldHint: The site's Team field, which names a milestone's team.
mapping.notDiscovered: Test the connection first: the mapping is checked against what a test discovers.
mapping.tokenUnreadable: The stored token cannot be decrypted. Edit the connection and enter the token again.

validation.levelOrder: Levels must decrease from program to project to milestone
validation.factor: Enter a number greater than 0 and at most 1000, with at most two decimals

peek.title: Peek at an issue
peek.keyHint: Reads one issue through the mapping. Nothing is stored.
peek.keyInvalid: Enter an issue key like ABC-12
peek.noLevel: None (the issue's level is not mapped)
peek.rawNone: The issue has none of the mapped fields.
peek.notFound: Jira does not know this issue (or the connection is gone).
peek.tokenUnreadable: The stored token cannot be decrypted. Edit the connection and enter the token again.
peek.mappingInvalid: The mapping in force (the saved one, or the defaults when none is saved) no longer fits the Jira site, or cannot be read. Correct it in the mapping section above and save it, then peek again.
peek.upstream: Jira could not be reached or refused the request:

bindings.title: Links to plan items
bindings.intro: The plan items linked to Jira items through this connection. Unlinking changes nothing in Jira.
bindings.empty: No plan item is linked through this connection yet.
bindings.deadNote: Links to deleted plan items are not listed here.
bindings.unlinkBody: {{name}} will no longer be linked to {{key}}. Nothing changes in Jira, and both can be linked again.
bindings.unlinkForbidden: Only the item's owners and administrators can unlink it.
bindings.importDisabled: Import from Jira needs an enabled connection that has passed Test connection.

bind.title: Link to Jira
bind.intro: Links one plan item to one Jira item. Astrolabe only reads from Jira, nothing is written there. Each side can be linked once.
bind.loadFailed: Could not load the Jira connections
bind.noConnections: No Jira connection has been set up yet.
bind.noConnectionsUser: An administrator has to add one first.
bind.allDisabled: Every Jira connection is disabled. An administrator has to enable one.
bind.mappingNote: The mapping of this connection does not fit the Jira site now, so linking is refused until an administrator fixes it.
bind.noMatchingPrograms: No matching programs you may link
bind.pickHint: Only items you own (or any item, as an administrator) can be linked.
bind.issueKeyHint: Like ABC-12. The issue must belong to one of the connection's projects and sit at the level the mapping gives this plan item type.
bind.keyInvalid: Enter an issue key like ABC-12

error.mappingInvalid: The connection's mapping no longer fits the Jira site. An administrator has to fix it on the connection page.
error.notDiscovered: This connection has not been tested yet. An administrator has to test it first.
error.tokenUnreadable: The connection's token cannot be read. An administrator has to enter it again.
error.rateLimited: Too many link attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.upstream: Jira could not be reached or refused the request:
error.gone: This plan item no longer exists.

bind.pickConnection: Choose a connection to link through.

import.title: Import from Jira
import.reading: Reading Jira… a large scope can take up to 3 minutes. Nothing is changed yet.

scope.intro: Reads the connection's Jira projects and shows what importing them into one work stream would do. Nothing is changed until you confirm, existing plan items are never overwritten, and nothing is written to Jira. Plan items are matched by name under the same parent, so an item renamed in Jira shows up as new.
scope.workStreamHint: Everything is created under this work stream.
scope.noConnection: No Jira connection can import right now: an administrator has to add, enable and test one.
scope.ownerHint: Every program and project that is created gets this owner.
scope.keysHint: All are read. Narrow this when a scope has more than 2,000 issues.
scope.keysRequired: Pick at least one Jira project
scope.copyDatesHint: Dates are copied only to milestones whose team you manage; the others are created unscheduled.
scope.teamHint: For milestones whose Jira team matches no team here. Without one, those milestones are skipped.
scope.programHint: Where projects with no parent in Jira go. Optional.
scope.projectHint: Where milestones with no parent in Jira go. Optional.

preview.title: What the import would do
preview.truncated: More than 2,000 issues are in scope. Only the first 2,000 are shown and nothing can be imported. Go back and narrow the Jira projects, then preview again.
preview.unscheduledRights: {{n}} of {{of}} milestones with dates will be created unscheduled: you do not manage their teams.
preview.unmatchedTeams: Jira teams that match no team here: {{names}}. Their milestones use the default team, or are skipped without one.
preview.selectAllAria: Select all rows that can be imported
preview.empty: Nothing in scope: the selected Jira projects have no issues at the mapped levels.
preview.alsoTicked_one: Ticked {{key}} and the item it is created under.
preview.alsoTicked_other: Ticked {{key}} and the {{count}} items it is created under.
preview.alsoUnticked_one: Unticked {{key}} and the {{count}} item created under it: it would be skipped.
preview.alsoUnticked_other: Unticked {{key}} and the {{count}} items created under it: they would be skipped.

row.parentUnticked: Its parent {{key}} is not ticked, so this is not imported.

reason.alreadyBound: Already linked to a plan item.
reason.noParent: Nowhere to put it: its parent is not in the plan. Pick a default program or project, or import its parent.
reason.nameTaken: A plan item with this name already exists here and cannot be linked.
reason.levelUnmapped: Its Jira type is not mapped to a plan level.
reason.noTeam: No team: its Jira team matches none here and no default team is set.
reason.parentSkipped: Its parent is skipped, so it is skipped too.
reason.changed: Changed since the preview, in Jira or in the plan. Preview again.

info.datesNotManaged: Dates not copied: you do not manage the team
info.datesInvalid: Jira's dates are missing or invalid: created unscheduled
info.noWorkingDay: Jira's dates hold no working day: created unscheduled
info.keptAsParent: Kept as a parent of an item shown here
info.parentUnreadable: Its parent in Jira could not be read (deleted, or not visible to the connection's account)

outcome.title: Import finished
outcome.wrote: The plan has been updated. Nothing was written to Jira.
outcome.nothing: Nothing was created or linked: every selected row was skipped.
outcome.changed_one: {{count}} row changed since the preview and was skipped. Preview again to see the current state.
outcome.changed_other: {{count}} rows changed since the preview and were skipped. Preview again to see the current state.

error.timeoutPreview: Reading Jira took longer than 3 minutes and was stopped. Narrow the Jira projects and try again.
error.timeoutApply: The import ended without a clear answer, so it may still have been applied. Close this dialog and check the "Links to plan items" list on this page, then preview again.
error.mappingChanged: The connection's mapping or discovery changed while the import was read, so nothing was written.
error.mappingInvalid: The connection's mapping no longer fits the Jira site. An administrator has to fix it on the connection page.
error.notDiscovered: This connection has not been tested yet. Test it first.
error.tokenUnreadable: The connection's token cannot be read. Enter it again by editing the connection.
error.gone: Something the import refers to no longer exists:
error.conflict: The plan or the connection changed while importing. Nothing was written. Preview again to see the current state.
error.rateLimited: Too many import requests: previews and imports share a limit of 5 a minute. Wait a minute and try again.
error.upstream: Jira could not be reached or refused the request:
